newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Montenegro court fines opposition leader for libel.
newsitem.headline: Montenegro court fines opposition leader for libel.

text.p: A Montenegro court has fined opposition National Accord coalition leader Novak Kilibarda for insulting the republic's leadership during last year's election campaign, the state news agency Tanjug reported on Tuesday.

A court in the town of Niksic fined Kilibarda 85,000 dinars ($15,000) for damaging the "reputation, honour and dignity" of Montenegro's President Momir Bulatovic and parliament speaker Svetozar Marovic, Tanjug said.

Bulatovic and Marovic had filed private libel suits against Kilibarda and another leader of the National Accord, Slavko Perovic, late last year for insulting them during and after the coalition's campaign in parliamentary and local elections.
The republican president and parliament speaker demanded 131,492 dinars in damages.
The court ruled that Kilibarda should pay Bulatovic 55,000 and Marovic 30,000 dinars.
A court in Cetinje on Monday postponed Perovic's trial due to overcrowding in the courtroom.
